Definition: from G303 and G3618; to rebuild:--build again.
BiblicalUsage: Amos quotes the promise to rebuild the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and James takes up the same words at the council in Jerusalem. The word is the rebuilding of what has fallen down, stone set back on stone.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for rebuilding carries no doctrine of its own; its promise is Amos's, that God will raise up again what has fallen.
